narration.transcript: Want the look of old timber beams without the weight? Meet Heritage Timber from Ekena Millwork. Each beam is molded from real, weathered timber with no corner seams. Pick from six textures, Mina, salvaged timber, rustic sawn, resawn rip, reclaimed axe cut, and sanded smooth, then a hand-stained finish, sandstone, Kona Brown, vanilla chai, warm caramel, natural white oak, smoky brown, or primed, ready to paint. Eight sizes, from three and a half inches square to nine and a half by eleven and a half, in lengths from four to twenty-four feet. They're hollow, so they slide over a wood block on your ceiling and can hide wiring. And they ship fast, stained beams in three to five business days, primed in about one to three days. Order a sample and see it in your own light.
